name: Palm Springs International Airport

runway.v: two parallel runways; the longer, 13R/31L, is 10,000 ft x 150 ft (about 3,048 m x 46 m); the other is 4,953 ft x 75 ft

curfew.v: no curfew: the airport says federal law (Airport Noise and Capacity Act 1990) does not allow it to impose curfews on compliant aircraft
curfew.quote: Under the Airport Noise and Capacity Act of 1990, airports cannot impose curfews or restrict compliant aircraft operations.

customs.v: CBP user-fee airport; arrival inspections 7 days a week 06:00-23:00 (office weekdays 08:00-17:00 Pacific); contact CBP at least one business day before arrival; permission valid +/-30 minutes; processing in the CBP general aviation facility; customs fee on all arrivals (schedule from the FBO)

ppr.v: for international arrivals, contact CBP at least one business day before arrival
ppr.quote: Pilots must secure permission to land by contacting CBP at least one business day in advance

notes: Runway from the FAA airport diagram for cycle 26 Nov-24 Dec 2026 (current); the labels are placed next to each runway, not tied to it in the text; ft to m conversion mine. Curfew statement from the City of Palm Springs airport noise page (last updated 10 Jun 2026). CBP fact sheet dated 29 May 2024 (KPSP-0524). FAA Chart Supplement and the FAA page faa.gov/psp (no rule content) gave no hours.
